Invented by ­Danelectro® in 1999, this pedal has achieved cult status. Originals cost a small fortune. Why? Because of its warm violin-like, organ-like tone. It literally flips the phrase you just played and plays it ­backwards. There’s nothing like it! Party like it’s 1999. Because it is! Buy the Back Talk ™ Sweetwater www.sweetwater.com Buy It Look closely at the boards of top L.A. and Nashville players and you will see the 1990’s Ibanez® ­Mostortion™ again and again. Danelectro® brings back this awesome pedal, nailing the original tone and grit, but also adding 2 tasty ­clipping ­options. Better than ever!
